subject: Payment block at Astra Health — executive outreach & VAT split proposal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@astrahealth.com>, procurement@astrahealth.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Invoice INV-2025-0193 overdue — VAT allocation required

Hi Marta / Procurement team,

Following up on INV-2025-0193 (Net: €58,950; Gross: €70,000) — this invoice is now 28 days past due. Our AR system shows a VAT allocation question on your side (reverse charge vs. local VAT) is holding payment. I've attached the invoice PDF for reference.

Next steps we can offer immediately:
- If you can confirm the VAT treatment (reverse charge vs. VAT charged) by EOD Thursday we'll clear the payment block on our end.
- If you need documentation from us, I can attach our EU VAT certificate and an itemized tax breakdown.

If we don't see a firm commitment by next Monday we'll need to escalate to an executive touchpoint to avoid service disruption. We prefer to avoid a credit hold, so please let me know the fastest way to get the VAT clarification.

Attachments: INV-2025-0193.pdf (invoice)

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@astrahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@astrahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-06T20:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2025-0193 overdue — VAT allocation required

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the follow-up. We've flagged the invoice internally because our tax team needs a VAT certificate that explicitly shows Redwood's VAT registration for EU sales. Without that, our AP team cannot book the reverse charge and will withhold VAT until the accounting treatment is confirmed.

Action from our side:
- Procurement will ask the tax team for final clarification (likely by Nov 10).
- We will not be able to commit to payment until we have their sign-off. Apologies for the delay — we realise this impacts your cashflow.

Would you be able to provide the VAT certificate and a short breakdown showing how much VAT is being charged vs net? If you can share a proposed phased payment schedule we can review it with procurement and legal.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Astra Health

Hi Marta,

Appreciate the quick reply. Attached is our EU VAT certificate and an itemised tax breakdown for this invoice — the VAT amount was calculated per the Netherlands VAT guidance for cross-border services (cloud/SAAS). For clarity: the invoice was issued gross at €70,000; we are prepared to reissue a net invoice with a reverse-charge note if your tax team confirms reverse charge applies.

Attachments: VAT_cert_Astra.pdf (VAT registration), invoice_tax_breakdown.xlsx (breakdown)

Given the timing, we're open to a short phased payment: 50% by Nov 12 and remaining 50% by Nov 30, conditional on procurement confirming their VAT position. If that works I can prepare a formal payment agreement (one-page) for signature.

If we don't receive at least the first payment by Nov 12, we will need to consider a temporary credit restriction. I'm hoping to avoid that and would prefer an executive outreach to accelerate review.

Cheers,
Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-10T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Escalation: Astra payment block — request for executive outreach and temporary concession

Team,

Summary: Astra Health (DBL-789) has an open invoice INV-2025-0193 for €70,000. Customer has asked for VAT supporting docs (attached) and has indicated AP will hold payment until tax sign-off (~Nov 10). They've asked for a phased payment proposal.

Why escalate:
- Balance is material to this quarter's AR (€70k).
- Customer is strategic (multi-year platform deal) and we want to avoid a credit hold that would impact their production traffic.
- Procurement is slow; tax sign-off timeline is uncertain.

What I propose we authorize now (need approval):
1) Executive outreach: Laura to send a short note from Redwood Exec to Astra CFO / Head of Procurement to accelerate tax review.
2) Conditional concession: Offer the 50/50 phased pay plan (50% by Nov 12) and remove the automated credit hold for a limited 7-day window once the payment agreement is signed.
3) Written agreement: Legal to sign a one-page payment agreement; we'll attach a payment_agreement_template.pdf and require signature before concession.

Questions for leadership:
- Approve the 50/50 split and 7-day hold removal?
- Approve escalation email (I can draft)?

I've attached the VAT certificate and the invoice. If approved I'll proceed with the executive outreach today.

Attachments: VAT_cert_Astra.pdf, INV-2025-0193.pdf, payment_agreement_template.pdf

Thanks,
Jonas
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@astrahealth.com>, procurement@astrahealth.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-12T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Payment block at Astra Health — executive outreach & VAT split proposal

Hi Marta — copying our finance & legal leads to keep this moving.

I’m Laura Bennett (Head of Revenue Operations at Redwood). I don’t want a tax paperwork question to delay your access to the platform. We’re prepared to accept a phased payment as follows:

- 50% of the gross invoice (€35,000) by COB Friday, Nov 12;
- Remaining 50% (€35,000) by COB Nov 30;
- Before we remove the credit hold we will require the signed one-page payment agreement (attached) and confirmation from your procurement that they will process the second payment on Nov 30.

Please confirm by reply if procurement / tax will approve this approach today. If helpful, I can jump on a 20-minute call with your AP & tax team tomorrow morning to walk through the VAT certificate and signing steps.

If I don’t hear back by 5pm Nov 12 we will apply a temporary credit restriction and route services to a reduced capacity mode while we resolve the arrears. We want to avoid that.

Attachments: payment_agreement_template.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
